_comment: STILL image generation (profile headshots, classroom stills).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: average height, slightly soft build, comfortable and unhurried

face: friendly lived-in face, laugh lines everywhere, twinkling light-brown eyes, tan skin with warm undertone, greying moustache and short stubble, slightly crooked front tooth
hair: short salt-and-pepper hair, receding a little, combed simply

wardrobe.teaching: plain button-up shirt (checked or pale blue) with the sleeves rolled, a knitted vest in cooler shots, comfortable trousers
alternates: light jacket and flat cap outdoors

accessories: a real till slip or airtime voucher held up
simple watch with a worn strap

presence.posture: holds the slip up at eye level, taps it with a finger, shrugs amiably; leans on the counter
presence.default_expression: amused and kind, mid-chuckle, the face of a man who has explained this at a shop counter a hundred times

environment: shop counter or kitchen table, till slips and small change, shelves warmly out of focus
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, American classroom props, chalkboard gibberish, unreadable equations, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, grey seamless or softly blurred classroom background
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

classroom.camera: full-frame, 35mm f/2.8 for context or 50mm f/2 for waist-up
classroom.lighting: practical daylight from classroom windows plus soft fill; avoid flat overhead fluorescent
classroom.framing: waist-up with the board visible over the shoulder, or wider three-quarter with the tutor mid-gesture
